entities.name: Post-Duvalier Transition and 1987 Constitution
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The fall of Baby Doc was followed by a period of military-civilian government, a new democratic constitution ratified in 1987, and the Ruelle Vaillant massacre of voters at polling stations that derailed the first election attempt.
